title: Database Normalization
misconceptions: Normalization completely eliminates all data redundancy in a relational database.
A higher normal form is always superior for system performance.
First Normal Form only requires setting a primary key on a table.
Denormalization is an incorrect design practice that should never be used.

rubric.text: Defines database normalization as a systematic process for reducing data redundancy.
Explains that database normalization prevents modification anomalies.
States that First Normal Form requires every column to contain atomic values.
Defines a functional dependency as a relationship where one attribute uniquely determines another.
States that Second Normal Form eliminates partial functional dependencies.
States that Third Normal Form eliminates transitive functional dependencies.
Explains that higher normal forms can decrease read performance due to additional joins.
States that denormalization is a valid technique to optimize read speed.
